name: field-agent
description: Implement a compliant FIELD-governed agent with the field-agent client SDK from Spin State Labs. Skills, templates, and knowledge for the three hooks (governed actions, strict usage metering, fail-closed liveness), operator bootstrap, the raw-REST path for non-Python agents, and a compliance verification checklist. Companion to the 'field' plugin: field is design-time governance (the manifest); field-agent is build-time integration (the code).
